title: Named shadow `info`, state.reported
description: state.reported of the AWS IoT named shadow `info` (GetNamedShadow accepted). Also pushed by the cloud itself with client_token=None and only {online, disconnectReason}.

AntiMoldNotification.x-note: shadow: True for all three units; meaning not established

CleanFilterNotification.x-note: shadow: True for all three units regardless of the status field CleanNotification; meaning not established

CleanNotification.x-note: status: 1 on exactly the two units for which the official app showed the freeze-clean prompt, 0 on the third (2026-09-16); registration: 3 (support mask)

CleanSecondaryFilterNotification.x-note: shadow: False for all three units; meaning not established

disconnectReason.x-note: cloud-initiated shadow updates carry 'CLIENT_INITIATED_DISCONNECT' with online False and no client token when a client (the official app or this library) disconnects

online.x-note: shadow: True for all three units while one of them answered the 6-byte frame, so it does not mean 'answers JSON'
